sources.title: Constitution and By-laws of the Jicarilla Apache Tribe of the Jicarilla Apache Indian Reservation, New Mexico —1937edition
sources.publisher: Jicarilla Apache Tribe; U.S. Department of the Interior, Government Printing Office; Library of Congress reading copy
sources.type: Government / archive — historical primary constitutional text
sources.annotation: An actual1937primary text supplies a particular Jicarilla constitutional perspective. It is a historical edition, not verified current law or the beginning of Jicarilla peoplehood. Current membership and governmental arrangements are not inferred.
sources.contentReviewScope: Actual eight-page scanned PDF: title/imprint; printed1–3 and5–6 (PDF3–5,7–8), including preamble, organization, powers, amendment and certification. No later amended constitution or implementation review.
sources.publicationDate: 1937 Government Printing Office imprint; federal approval August4,1937

claimBlocks.text: The Jicarilla1937constitution provides for a representative council chosen through districts and an executive committee accountable to it. Its certification records tribal ratification on July3 and federal approval on August4. The text recognizes earlier tribal powers while describing a particular institutional arrangement. It supplies a historical Jicarilla example, rather than evidence that the people began in1937 or that its membership, election and federal-review provisions are current rules.
claimBlocks.sourceLocator: Printed1–3,5–6; organization ArticleV, powers ArticleVI, certification6

inspections.method: Actual Library of Congress eight-page primary scan opened and selected substantive text read, including certification. OCR duplicates some page text; the repeated passages are one source, not additional works.
inspections.limits: No exact current eligibility, legal advice, precise district boundaries, vote totals, independent implementation or all-Apache constitution claim. The1938corporate charter is a separate unread lead and adds no count. The1937historical edition is distinct from the modern amended text, whose NILL listing reports limited online permission; that modern text was not pursued.

excludedHostObservations.status: A stale university directory pointed to this domain. Actual opening displayed unrelated commercial/book/gambling content, not a Jicarilla government publication. Excluded as current community authority; no main source card or instruction to follow its links.
